name: Solution Sketching (4-Step)

steps.text: Run four timed beats: silent gathering, rough ideation, eight quick variations, then a three-panel sketch.
First, have everyone review the framing and research silently and take notes without discussion.
Next, each person diagrams possible flows privately, then pushes the strongest one through eight one-minute riffs.
Finish with a three-panel storyboard that a stranger can follow without a spoken explanation.
Collect the sketches anonymously and hang them side by side for a silent read before any discussion.

failure: Half-working looks like a sketch of arrows and empty boxes that only its author can narrate: the idea dies the moment the author steps away.
intervention: Ask whether a stranger could follow the sketch without you, then add real headlines, button labels, and callouts until the answer is yes.
provenance: Source protocol: the steps follow the written script in the source.
